Hannah (AE): dropping OrionEdge POC redlines — procurement asks: net45, PO before countersign, explicit test-data deletion, and KMS/HSM attestation in MSA. attaching redline PDF.
Marta - Legal: quick Q: do they process regulated data (PCI/HIPAA)? and which Redwood entity will sign?
Hannah (AE): not HIPAA, some payment analytics (PII). Redwood US to sign. procurement specifically asked for HSM-level attestation.
Leo (SE): tech note: Hosted supports customer-managed keys (procedural attestation). HSM hardware attestation only on Dedicated with HSM-backed KMS. We can offer SOC reports for Hosted.
Vik (Presales): recommend offering a short Dedicated trial window to satisfy HSM ask and latency SLO. will raise cost by ~30% for the trial.
June (Finance): net45 ok for POC if PO + billing contact provided before countersign. Invoice to "OrionEdge AP"; first invoice after trial month.
Marta - Legal: redline hotspots: (1) SLA — they want p95 <150ms for inference during POC (2) KMS indemnity warranty (3) subprocessor clause for embeddings vendor 00. need vendor list.
Leo (SE): p95 150ms is realistic only on Dedicated at their projected qps. Hosted p95 will be higher. suggest compromise language pointing to Dedicated addendum for firm p95 SLA.
Marta - Legal: draft compromise: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet latency SLOs; firm p95 latency SLAs will be set forth in a Dedicated deployment addendum." ok?
Hannah (AE): that should work. procurement also wants sign flow: Procurement -> Customer Legal -> Redwood Exec, with countersign within 3 business days.
June (Finance): we can e-sign and meet 3 business days if PO and billing contact are in advance. finance needs PO on file prior to countersign for net45.
ContractsBot: ACTIONS SUMMARY: [Legal: Marta to draft MSA reply with Dedicated-addendum fallback & KMS language (ETA 1bd); SE: Leo to attach perf matrix + Dedicated trial cost (ETA EOD); Sales: Hannah to collect PO, billing contact, signer names (ETA today); Finance: June to confirm invoice flow/net45 on orderform (ETA EOD).]
Hannah (AE): pinging OrionEdge procurement now, cc @Vik to offer Dedicated trial. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree.
Marta - Legal: :thumbsup:
Leo (SE): :thumbsup:
June (Finance): :thumbsup:
Vik (Presales): :thumbsup:
Hannah (AE): thanks team 8079; will update when PO + signers come back.
